class Stack
  class StackUnderflowError < StandardError; end

  def initialize
    @array = []
  end

  def push(element)
    @array.push(element)
  end

  def pop
    raise StackUnderflowError if empty?
    @array.pop
  end

  def peek
    raise StackUnderflowError if empty?
    @array.last
  end

  def empty?
    @array.empty?
  end
end
